summaryZh: Hearing & Brain Health Lab研究认知衰老与听觉神经科学的交叉问题，关注年龄相关听力损失如何改变大脑，以及这些变化为何可能增加痴呆风险。首页未说明具体实验方法。
researchQuestions: 年龄相关听力损失如何改变大脑？
这些脑变化为何可能增加痴呆风险？

evidence.quote: Megan Fitzhugh, PhD Assistant P rofessor Department of Neurosciences University of California San Diego

Our goal is to build a new line of research at the crossroads of cognitive aging and auditory neuroscience. We focus on understanding how age-related hearing loss changes the brain and why those changes may increase the risk of dementia.
